info.name: OAN A2C - Farmer (IAM Portal + eSignet)
info.description:
Farmer flow for the A2C API (/api/v1):
1. Log in through iam-bene-portal-api + eSignet (OTP). The IAM access token becomes the Bearer token.
2. oan_auth_service validates the token through IAM get_user_profile and maps IAM client roles to A2C Farmer.
3. Call farmer-facing endpoints: dashboard, catalog, saved products, applications.
Run folder 1 first, then 2-5. Set individual id and OTP in the environment.
